summary: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 23,000,000 common shares at $3.50 per share, raising $80.5 million gross ($75.67 million net). Underwriters hold a 30-day option for 3,450,000 additional shares. Joint bookrunners are TD Cowen, Guggenheim Securities, and Oppenheimer Co. This is an ordinary public equity offering, not a special situation, so the appropriate classification is None.
